notes: RFQs: the RFQ screen now shows how many live RFQs you have. Tap it to open your RFQs and history.
Product photos open faster, with a picture of the product while the full photo loads.
Photos in the grid show a placeholder while they load, so tiles never look stuck.
Small vibrations for key moments: saving, status changes, accepting quotes, merging and deleting.
Password reset links now show which account they are for before they sign you in.
Mac: the X in the search bar clears the search, and you can double-click to select search text.
Security improvements.
Larger text sizes now work across the app, with a size limit so screens stay usable.
Settings values line up on the right.
Hold a product to start selecting many products.
A progress message shows while emails send.
Mac: Filters opens as a popover.
Fixes when you switch accounts: settings and vendor uploads stay with the right account.
Test build for the next version. Same features as 1.1.7, which is in App Store review.
Fix: the Feature Tour no longer closes the app on the product page slide.
Reply to a comment right from the notification, with the keyboard.
Notification photos are sharper.
Deleting many products or vendors at once is smoother, and vendors ask before deleting.
Faster Products list with large catalogs.
Change Password in Profile.
Email templates for each status, and vendors with the same name stay separate.
Ctnr Qty accepts only numbers or ?. Letters and other characters are refused.
Edit Product: clearing Ctnr Qty now saves ? (unknown) instead of 0.
Search by photo: tap the camera next to the search bar to find a product from a picture. Recent searches are one tap away.
Visually Similar: see look-alike products on every product page.
Email suppliers from Outlook or Gmail, with CC. Pick several products and each supplier gets one email, with the photos inline.
Supplier emails are checked: a red mark shows an address that cannot get mail, with a one-tap fix.
Venues are shared with your team. Rename one and everyone sees it.
Card scans read every card on a supplier, plus many fixes.
RFQs: send vendors one link. They quote on a web form or an Excel sheet, with photos and price by quantity. Compare landed cost and accept with one tap.
Your team logo on every RFQ form.
Invite teammates for free. You pay for a seat only when they join.
EU import duties: choose the US or the EU as your destination.
Settings search, Select All, Share as Excel or PDF, faster grids and many fixes.
Autofill: fill in a product from its photo text and voice note, and review every suggestion on one screen
Clearer tariff search: see each code's category path and duty rate
iPad: your product list and the product side by side, like Vendors
Adding seats now shows the exact price and asks you to confirm before charging
Seats removed within 24 hours of buying them are refunded
Only the team owner can invite new members
New privacy setting: Smart Card Reading, to keep card scanning fully on your device
Cards scanned offline are read again when you are back online
Smarter card scan: job titles, office and factory addresses, and English names first
Multiple cards: swipe between a vendor's cards, newest first
Select text: copy any text right off a card photo
Scan a stack of cards at once: cards from the same company are grouped into one vendor
Vendor notes: write down what you remember about each vendor
Price in RMB: see the USD amount as you type, and convert with one tap
Photo text: search the words printed on your product photos
Faster, more reliable sync, even offline
Show Sourcing 1.1 is our biggest update yet.
Custom fields: add your own fields for the whole team, and search and filter by them.
Fields per category: show a field only for the categories it fits.
Choice fields: set the options once, then pick with a tap.
Card scan reads QR codes: vCard, WhatsApp, website, email and phone. WeChat and WhatsApp QR codes show on the vendor page.
Price breaks: a quantity price ladder for every product.
Price terms: FOB, CIF, EXW or DDP, with landed cost to match.
Export to Excel: products and vendors with photos in the cells and every field. We email you a link (paid plans).
Mac and iPad: products, vendors and settings side by side, with keyboard shortcuts.
AI Connection: connect ChatGPT or Claude to your catalog and ask about your finds.
US shipping records on vendor pages.
Photo descriptions: AI writes a short description of each photo (iOS 27).
Help & FAQ with search, and a What's New page.
Team statuses you choose.
Team Map shows who is at the same venue.
Faster camera with instant thumbnails and a zoom dial.
Prices and numbers follow your region's format.
Your display settings follow you to every device.
Every plan gets a team, so people you invite are covered.
Faster and smoother everywhere.
Card photos delete the right card, and merged vendors no longer leave a copy behind.
New devices get every product's details.
Photos no longer go missing after a delete.
Tariff nicknames: name an HTS code once ("Speaker") and every product in that category gets the official US rate, including Section 301 and the current country duty.
Tariff search in plain words: type "power bank" and find the right tariff line.
Category groups: group categories (even groups inside groups) and filter Products by a whole family.
Text on product photos is read and searchable, with Chinese translated to English.
Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your catalog (read-only) from Settings.
Ask Siri to find a product in Show Sourcing.
US customs shipping history on vendor pages.
Redesigned Create, Edit and Filters with clearer cards and larger labels.
One badge shows and switches the category-tariff link.
New "Tariff not linked" filter.
Grid shows status as a color dot; the filter icon fills when filters are on.
Tariff rates now refresh reliably, and country rates match current US rules.
Settings no longer shows a double Back button.
Subscriptions stay in sync with payments.
Sign-up catches mistyped email domains.
Smoother initial sync — the app stays interactive while your catalog downloads (no more freeze on first sign-in).
Catalog rows on smaller iPhones now show LDP clearly instead of the price wrapping under its label.
Faster vendor card scanning + better duplicate-vendor merging.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.
Fixed an issue where editing one product could overwrite or blank another product's vendor.
Faster business card scanning with improved accuracy on multi-photo vendors.
Better duplicate-vendor merging — no more leftover ghosts after merging.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.
Notifications now reliably appear in the alerts tab, even if push delivery is missed
Long-press the camera button in a product's media row to open the photo picker
Filter sheet: stepper buttons next to FOB, MOQ, and Comments fields for quick adjustments
Filter sheet: date range picker now collapses when no dates are selected
Catalog title shows product count with a filter indicator when filters are active
Reorganized Settings with a new Support section
Fixed push notifications not being delivered
Fixed product dates showing incorrect order in the catalog
Catalog now shows product count
Products sorted by newest first by default
App messages now update in real time
Improved data sync reliability
Reorganized Settings with a new Support section
First release of Show Sourcing.
Sign in with Apple: accounts made on the iPhone with Apple now work on Android.
A welcome tour for new users, with a note from the founder.
Draw on product photos, erase and crop. Drawings made on the iPhone now show on Android.
Share a photo with its drawings.
Slide a list row left to delete it (Products list, Vendors, Team).
Photo descriptions and text from the photos show on the product page, and search finds them.
A map under the vendor's address, the card's text with Copy, and phone types (Mobile, Office, Fax).
Filter products by who is tagged in the comments.
Vendor sort by date added; tap the same sort again to flip it.
Pictures in alerts, and reply to a comment right from the alert.
App Tint and Tab Order in Settings.
Paste a photo to search or to add it to a product.
Hold the app icon for New Product, Scan Cards and Search.
